prompt: Identify the part with the grammatical error (or 'No error').
sentence: Although the public sector bank faced (A) / massive bad loan write-offs this fiscal year, (B) / but it managed to declare a minor net profit margin. (C) / No Error (D)
options: Although the public sector bank faced
massive bad loan write-offs this fiscal year,
but it managed to declare a minor net profit margin.
explanation: 'Although' and 'but' cannot be used together in the same sentence; drop 'but' so it reads 'it managed to declare a minor net profit margin'.
